meta.title: Bay Area AI startup map
meta.definition: An agent product carries out multistep tasks for a user through tools or computer interfaces, as described on the company website. Agent builders and infrastructure are a separate, optional layer.
meta.scope: Curated initial collection of 12 companies with a reported Bay Area presence: two have independently corroborated city and category; ten remain candidates pending confirmation. Not exhaustive; includes growth-stage startups. One Bay Area city per company, resolved by website domain.
meta.review_method: AI-assisted review of company product pages, company updates, and employer job boards. Product behavior has not been independently tested. No human-labeled validation sample; precision and recall have not been measured.
meta.location_policy: All records are city-level. Coordinates on the map belong to city reference points, never to companies. No jitter. No street or office locations have been independently geocoded. No Form D or DataSF registry matches were completed for this edition.
meta.activity_policy: A resolving product site plus a dated update within 18 months or roles listed as open when checked. Undated job boards are provisional evidence and can be stale; observed_at is not a posting date. This is a dated snapshot, not a live monitor.
source_families: Y Combinator profiles and employer job boards
Independent reporting: TechCrunch and San Francisco Chronicle
meta.verification_policy: Corroborate city and product category using company evidence plus independent reporting before marking those fields corroborated. Multiple pages from the same company are one source family; employer-written directory profiles are self-reported evidence. Two records meet this standard; ten remain pending. This does not verify product performance, office occupancy, or every company claim.
